title: Upper-level outlook to adjoining public open space
text: Where adjoining public open space, dwellings with two or more storeys are to include an upper-level balcony and/or window to a habitable room which overlooks the public open space.

replaces.note: Part C C3.6.2 applied to multiple dwellings only; new for grouped dwellings

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as Chapter 2 C3.6.2. New design requirement for grouped dwellings backing onto POS (Part C C3.6.2 applied to multiple dwellings only). proposal.storeys is read per dwelling: any dwelling of two or more storeys adjoining the POS. 'Adjoining' POS is undefined.
